popupExpandToggleTip: Enlarge scrollable panels and iframes to their complete content instead of recording them as they stand in view. Frames from other sites ask one time for an extra permission.
optionsLead: Changes are saved automatically and synchronised with your browser profile.
optionsExpandPermGranted: Permission granted — frames from other sites are unfolded as well.
optionsExpandPermMissing: Without the "read all websites" permission, frames from other sites are recorded as they stand in view. Panels and iframes from the same site always work.
optionsRedactPIIDesc: Searches the text the page gives away for e-mail addresses, telephone numbers, credit card numbers, citizen service numbers and API keys and puts a dense block over what corresponds, in the saved image. Text that is drawn as pixels it cannot read — a canvas, an image, a PDF, a video picture. The recognition runs on your device; nothing is ever sent anywhere. Only with recordings of the whole page (document scroll); the block is permanent, so check the result yourself.
scrollclipFormatHint: GIF plays back everywhere. WebM is smaller and more fluid (recorded live in your own browser).
batchPermissionHint: For the opening of these pages, permission is needed one time, the first time.
batchPermissionDeclined: The permission to open those pages has been refused.
